package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for route_registration_contains_business_logic: Router setup files that build queries, mutate models, or execute business actions while registering routes.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
var db *gorm.DB

func SetupRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux) {
	var count int64
	db.Table("users").Count(&count)
	if count == 0 {
		db.Exec("INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ('admin')")
	}

	users, _ := db.Table("users").Select("id, name").Rows()
	defer users.Close()

	mux.HandleFunc("/users", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		var total int64
		db.Table("users").Count(&total)
		if total > 1000 {
			http.Error(w, "too many users, registration blocked", http.StatusForbidden)
			return
		}
		w.Write([]byte("users"))
	})

	mux.HandleFunc("/health", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Write([]byte("ok"))
	})
}
